text: DASHBOARDSCREEN — THE NINETEENTH SCREEN TEMPLATE. Figures about one or many programmes, filtered by area and period: the way back, the area bar ("Figures for All India", announced when it changes) with its filters on one baseline, one sentence where an area choice changes only part of the page, then the view. It owns the seven states through `ScreenBody` and moves focus to the new view's heading when the view changes — except after a filter, which keeps the reader on it. The website's Beneficiary Dashboard is built on it. Catalogue: docs/design-system/screen-templates.md §4.19. In Figma: a wireframe card in the Screen Templates anatomy grid and a full-size frame (desktop and phone) in the new Figures for Everyone section.
